# SPACE CAT

> SPACE CAT is a pure DOS-style mission-control terminal for space enthusiasts and the
> public website for Space Cat: Launch Terminal, a standalone Wear OS application.

## Canonical pages

- [Launch Terminal](https://spacecat.watch/): Product overview and interactive terminal.
- [Live Launch Sync](https://spacecat.watch/live): The next real rocket T-0 and mission status.
- [ASCII Launch](https://spacecat.watch/launch): Cinematic modeled launch sequence.
- [ISS Telemetry](https://spacecat.watch/iss): Live ISS position, altitude and velocity.
- [Solar Weather](https://spacecat.watch/solar): NOAA planetary K-index and storm state.
- [Félicette Memorial](https://spacecat.watch/felicette): Terminal archive for Félicette.
- [Privacy](https://spacecat.watch/privacy): App and website privacy policy.

## Application

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spacecat.terminal)
- Platform: Wear OS. A watchOS edition is in review.
- Model: one-time purchase; no subscription.
- Developer: BE Engineering.

## Data and accuracy

The website uses Launch Library 2, Spaceflight News API, Open-Meteo, NOAA SWPC and
wheretheiss.at. Live schedule and status data are distinguished from modeled ASCII ascent
profiles. SPACE CAT is not affiliated with SpaceX, NASA or any launch agency.

## Official social accounts

- [X](https://x.com/spacecatwatch)
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/spacecatwatch/)

This file is an experimental machine-readable orientation document. The canonical HTML
pages and their structured data remain the authoritative descriptions.
